simpledimensions.guide.command.given: You received the Simple Modpack guide; the Simple Dimensions chapter is open.
simpledimensions.guide.command.missing: The Simple Modpack guide is not installed (Simple Lib is missing).
simpledimensions.guide.page.1.title: Simple Dimensions
simpledimensions.guide.page.1: Configurable dimensions, light arches and safe linked portals.
simpledimensions.guide.page.2.title: Default Dimensions
simpledimensions.guide.page.2: Three dimensions exist from the first start, no setup needed: Skyblock (a void with a safe island to build on), Mining (a deep stone resource world) and Travel (a flat plane for fast travel).
simpledimensions.guide.page.3.title: Default Dimensions
simpledimensions.guide.page.3: Their definitions are written to config/simpledimensions/dimensions on the first start; existing files and worlds are never overwritten. Each one has a server switch (Enable Skyblock, Enable Mining, Enable Travel) that is on by default;
simpledimensions.guide.page.4.title: Default Dimensions
simpledimensions.guide.page.4: switching one off only stops new journeys, return paths stay open.
simpledimensions.guide.page.5.title: Skyblock
simpledimensions.guide.page.5: Build one of six glowstone arches and place a separate emitting block within three blocks of the interior. Glowstone, fire, soul fire, and portal blocks do not count. Ignite with flint and steel or one fire charge.
simpledimensions.guide.page.6.title: Skyblock
simpledimensions.guide.page.6: The light blue void has a bedrock arrival island whose diameter is the frame width plus four, and an exact return exit. No free resources are generated.
simpledimensions.guide.page.7.title: Mining Dimension
simpledimensions.guide.page.7: Portal rows: DXXD / D..D / D..D / D..D / DEED. D is deepslate bricks, X diamond ore, E emerald ore. One origin block maps to two mining blocks.
simpledimensions.guide.page.8.title: Mining Dimension
simpledimensions.guide.page.8: The forest flat preset has bedrock at -64, deepslate through 0, stone through 188, dirt at 189–190, and grass at 191. Vanilla biome features provide ores and trees; terrain is never reset.
simpledimensions.guide.page.9.title: Travel Dimension
simpledimensions.guide.page.9: Portal rows: KRRK / O..O / O..O / O..O / SSSS. K is a wither skeleton skull, R resin bricks, O dark oak logs, S soul sand. Ten origin blocks map to one travel block. The flat bedrock plane grants no extra movement speed.
simpledimensions.guide.page.10.title: Travel Dimension
simpledimensions.guide.page.10: Generated exits keep exact origins rather than selecting nearby foreign portals.
simpledimensions.guide.page.11.title: Portal Shapes
simpledimensions.guide.page.11: The six default matrices are AGA/G.G/G.G; AGGA/G..G/G..G/G..G; AGGGA/G...G/G...G/G...G; AAGGAA/AG..GA/G....G/G....G/G....G; AAGGGAA/AG...GA/G.....G/G.....G/G.....G; AAGGGGAA/AG....GA/G......G/G......G/G......G.
simpledimensions.guide.page.12.title: Portal Shapes
simpledimensions.guide.page.12: A is checked air, G glowstone, and dots become portal cells. Both horizontal axes work. Breaking the frame or removing required light dissolves outbound portal cells.
simpledimensions.guide.page.13.title: Safe Travel and Return
simpledimensions.guide.page.13: Only unmounted players travel. Items, mobs, mounts, and passengers are refused. Target registries, borders, build height, solid ground, headroom, claim permissions, and an exact return path are checked.
simpledimensions.guide.page.14.title: Safe Travel and Return
simpledimensions.guide.page.14: Builds use only empty cells and bedrock; valuable frames are never copied.
simpledimensions.guide.page.15.title: Safe Travel and Return
simpledimensions.guide.page.15: In terrain dimensions, the platform is raised above every existing block in its bounded footprint, including nonblocking plants.
simpledimensions.guide.page.16.title: Safe Travel and Return
simpledimensions.guide.page.16: Vegetation and existing builds are preserved. One build per server tick, at most nine chunks per build and 1,024 recorded portals.
simpledimensions.guide.page.17.title: Safe Travel and Return
simpledimensions.guide.page.17: Warmup is 0–200 ticks, cooldown 20–1,200 ticks, and players must leave the portal after arrival. Generated exits remain usable when access is disabled.
simpledimensions.guide.page.18.title: Safe Travel and Return
simpledimensions.guide.page.18: Missing definitions or falling near the void floor invokes the persisted safe origin; otherwise a checked overworld spawn is used.
simpledimensions.guide.page.19.title: Configuration and Data Packs
simpledimensions.guide.page.19: Server JSON: config/simpledimensions/server.json. Portal definitions: config/simpledimensions/dimensions/*.json; existing files are preserved.
simpledimensions.guide.page.20.title: Configuration and Data Packs
simpledimensions.guide.page.20: The mandatory generated pack loads on both loaders before world registries.
simpledimensions.guide.page.21.title: Configuration and Data Packs
simpledimensions.guide.page.21: At most 16 definitions, eight recipes each, 23×23 matrices, 21×21 interiors, eight extra origins, 64 KiB per input file, and coordinate ratios 0.5–10.
simpledimensions.guide.page.22.title: Configuration and Data Packs
simpledimensions.guide.page.22: Generation height is 16–384 in 16-block steps, minimum Y -64–0.
simpledimensions.guide.page.23.title: Configuration and Data Packs
simpledimensions.guide.page.23: Destinations stay in the isolated simpledimensions namespace. New dimensions require a world restart. preset and orePreset are retained legacy labels without generation effects.
simpledimensions.guide.page.24.title: Configuration and Data Packs
simpledimensions.guide.page.24: Access/Safety/Dimensions config tabs show defaults; multiplayer clients cannot edit server values. Nonplayer travel is reserved and permanently refused.
simpledimensions.guide.page.25.title: Configuration and Data Packs
simpledimensions.guide.page.25: Known claim mods require a registered permission integration; no claim bypass is offered. The Dimensions tab controls Skyblock, Mining, and Travel independently, all On by default.
simpledimensions.guide.page.26.title: Configuration and Data Packs
simpledimensions.guide.page.26: These server settings persist in server.json and apply immediately to the local integrated server. Dedicated servers read them at startup; remote clients cannot change them.
simpledimensions.guide.page.27.title: Configuration and Data Packs
simpledimensions.guide.page.27: Disabling access preserves dimension data and generated return portals. The old enabled flag in built-in dimension definitions is ignored; it remains supported for custom definitions.
simpledimensions.guide.page.28.title: Server Claim Permissions
simpledimensions.guide.page.28: Enabled Simple Tweaks claims are checked through the public framework API. Activation checks every frame and interior cell;
simpledimensions.guide.page.29.title: Server Claim Permissions
simpledimensions.guide.page.29: travel checks the source, linked destination, landing, and every generated platform cell. Disabled or absent Simple Tweaks adds no restrictions.
simpledimensions.guide.page.30.title: Getting the Guide
simpledimensions.guide.page.30: This guide is easy to get:
simpledimensions.guide.page.31.title: Getting the Guide
simpledimensions.guide.page.31: craft the Simple Modpack guide from a book and a crafting table, run /simpledimensions guide (any player) to receive it with this chapter open, or travel to a dimension for the first time and it is handed to you once.
simpledimensions.guide.page.32.title: Getting the Guide
simpledimensions.guide.page.32: The option Give Guide on First Trip (on by default) turns the gift off. Picking up flint and steel also opens this chapter.
simpledimensions.guide.page.33.title: Inventory and Rights
simpledimensions.guide.page.33: Your inventory stays with you: only unmounted players travel, items lying around, mobs and mounts stay behind. Anyone may use a portal and the guide command.
simpledimensions.guide.page.34.title: Inventory and Rights
simpledimensions.guide.page.34: Changing settings with /simpledimensions config needs permission level 2, and server claims decide who may build or ignite a portal.
simpledimensions.guide.page.35.title: Commands
simpledimensions.guide.page.35: /simpledimensions guide gives you the Simple Modpack guide with this chapter open (every player).
simpledimensions.guide.page.36.title: Commands
simpledimensions.guide.page.36: /simpledimensions config shows and changes every option of config/simpledimensions/server.json (list [group], get, set, reset, help; Tab completes options and values).
simpledimensions.guide.page.37.title: Commands
simpledimensions.guide.page.37: Values are bounded like in the file, saved at once and take effect at once. Config needs permission level 2.
